Provides anti-aliased rendering by treating rays as cones (via Gaussian approximation).
*   **When to use:** Unbounded scenes with large depth ranges where standard NeRF fails due to floaters or background collapse.
*   **When not to use:** Bounded scenes with small depth ranges where standard NeRF performs well.
It builds on the Mip-NeRF concept of anti-aliased volume rendering and extends it to unbounded scenes using coordinate contraction and disparity-based sampling.
